title: Exterior Painting in Alachua, FL | Stucco & Siding
description: Exterior painting in Alachua, FL built for humid summers and harsh west-wall sun: acrylic on siding, elastomeric on stucco, up to a 10-year warranty.
heroIntro: We prep and coat each side of an Alachua home based on the weather it faces, from the sun-baked west wall to the shaded side that grows mildew.

questions: When is the best season to paint a house exterior in Alachua?
Why is my west wall fading faster than the rest of the house?
What warranty comes with exterior painting?

sections.h2: Each side of the house fails differently
body: Walk around almost any home in Alachua and you'll see it. The south and west walls have chalked and bleached. The shaded north side has grown a green film. The bottom foot of siding and door trim is soft from rain splash and sprinklers. That's why we photograph and price each side separately during the walkthrough instead of charging one flat rate for the whole house.

The house's location in town also matters. A storefront on Historic Main Street usually needs patient scraping and spot-priming on old trim. A newer home in Cinnamon Hills or Turkey Creek is more likely to need stucco crack repair and caulk replacement. Large-lot homes up north often have long fascia runs and outbuildings that get the same treatment as the main house.

sections.h2: Matching the coating to the surface
body: We use 100% acrylic on siding and trim because it stays flexible through the heat swings that open and close joints. On stucco with hairline movement, we use an elastomeric that bridges small cracks instead of splitting along them. Exposed wood gets a penetrating stain instead of a film that can trap moisture. We use premium Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore products and name the exact one on the estimate. Two full coats are standard, with a third for dark-to-light color changes. Sprayed walls are back-rolled so the coating gets into the stucco texture.

bullets: Soft wash and mildew treatment, then enough dry time before primer goes on
Scrape failing paint back to a sound edge and sand glossy areas to dull them
Moisture readings on suspect fascia and sills, with rotted boards replaced
Cut out and re-caulk every moving joint with a flexible sealant
Spot-prime bare wood and stucco cracks before the topcoat

body: October through May is the best time for exterior work. From June into September, afternoon storms show up three or four days a week, so summer crews start early, watch the dew point, and check radar before opening a can. A full exterior usually takes three to seven working days, plus washing and dry time. Our article on how long exterior paint lasts in Florida explains what affects that number.

Most exteriors start with a soft wash in Alachua. If you're changing colors, pair the job with an exterior color consult. Our main exterior painting page covers the full method. For the town overview, see painting in Alachua.

faqs.q: Can you paint my Alachua house in summer?
faqs.a: Yes, with some adjustments. Crews start early, keep an eye on dew point and radar, and stop before the afternoon storms. If your schedule is flexible, October through May gives the most reliable drying conditions.

faqs.q: Do you replace rotted wood before painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Rotted trim and fascia are replaced rather than painted over. Any carpentry is listed on the written estimate before work begins.

faqs.q: What warranty comes with an exterior repaint?
faqs.a: A written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years on exterior projects, on top of the paint manufacturer's product warranty.

faqs.q: Why does elastomeric paint matter for stucco?
faqs.a: Stucco develops hairline cracks as it moves. Elastomeric coatings are thick and flexible enough to bridge those small cracks, so water can't get into the wall behind them.
